name: @dpdp/gateway-app
description: DPDP Gateway Setup -- a small Electron wizard/status app for the Gateway-only product. It walks a client through pairing the installed Windows Service with their DPDP workspace, and afterward shows connection status. No business logic lives here: it writes config.json/sources.json through the SAME validated agent modules the service itself uses (via a one-time elevated helper -- see gateway-installer/service/elevated-helper.ps1) and reads status from the agent's own loopback /health. It never calls the DPDP backend directly and never sees a device token.

scripts.test: node src/workspace-url.test.js && node src/elevated-command.test.js && node src/request-file.test.js && node src/config-path.test.js && node src/status-check.test.js && node src/wiring.test.js
